LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.NumericGroupDesc: Bonus curves for the six attributes. Changes apply immediately and are saved with the mod settings.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.GuildContentDesc: Guild envoys and guild quests are still in development and may be incomplete or hurt the experience. Enable to turn them on; when disabled, no new guild quest or envoy is sent, quests already accepted finish naturally, and familia rank and upgrade points are kept.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.CurveHint: The curve maps a raw attribute value to the value used for bonus calculation: the horizontal axis is the raw value and the vertical axis the effective value. Drag the points to adjust; double-click empty space to add a point; right-click a middle point to remove it; the horizontal position of both end points is fixed. Dragging and adding snap to steps of 100.
